name: Taxflow Connector
author: andrew2501hb

sections.description:
Taxflow Connector securely connects your WooCommerce store with the WooTax Cloud platform.

The plugin acts solely as a secure connector between your shop and WooTax Cloud. All accounting workflows, invoice processing and DATEV export generation are performed within the WooTax Cloud service.

This architecture keeps your WooCommerce installation lightweight while allowing WooTax Cloud to continuously improve export quality and accounting features without affecting your shop.

Features

  • Secure connection between WooCommerce and WooTax Cloud
  • Automatic invoice synchronization
  • Background processing for large exports
  • DATEV demo export
  • Cloud-based accounting workflow
  • Connection diagnostics
  • Health check
  • Guided demo interface focused on cloud benefits
  • Clear comparison of demo and full cloud functions
  • Optional custom add-ons for individual integrations
  • Compatible with WooCommerce HPOS
  • GDPR-friendly architecture

WooTax Cloud

After connecting your store you can:

  • synchronize invoices
  • create DATEV demo exports
  • review accounting data
  • monitor export history
  • manage multiple exports
  • use improved cloud processing
  • request individual add-ons for payment providers, marketplaces, bank/CSV formats, or special accounting rules

The connector itself does not generate DATEV exports locally. The free demo is limited server-side and is intended to demonstrate the WooTax Cloud workflow with a small number of shop orders.

Privacy

Taxflow Connector communicates with the WooTax Cloud service only after you configure and authorize the connection.

The plugin transfers only the data required for synchronization and export processing.

No advertising, tracking or analytics services are included.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Taxflow Connector.
  2. Open WooCommerce → Taxflow Connector.
  3. Connect your shop to WooTax Cloud.
  4. Verify the connection.
  5. Start your first synchronization.
sections.faq:
Is WooCommerce required?

Yes. Taxflow Connector requires WooCommerce.

Does this plugin generate DATEV exports locally?

No.

DATEV generation is performed by WooTax Cloud.

Is WooTax affiliated with WooCommerce or Automattic?

No.

WooTax is an independent cloud service.

Does the plugin work with HPOS?

Yes.

Taxflow Connector supports WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Can I test the plugin for free?

Yes.

The connector includes access to a limited demonstration workflow through WooTax Cloud.

  • Improved calls to action and the explanation of the server-side demo limit.

  • Initial public WordPress.org release.
  • Modernized interface.
  • Improved cloud connectivity.
  • Better diagnostics.
  • HPOS compatibility improvements.
  • Performance optimizations.
  • Stability improvements.
